# Update every consumer when a shared fake server adds a capability

763 adds DSN to the fake SMTP capability list. 764 updates test_guessConfig expected responses and moves the STARTTLS insertion position from 5 to 6. Shared fake-server protocol behavior is an input to account-discovery tests as well as send tests. Check the complete expected response and the insertion index together when adding a capability. This source follow-up supports the breakage pattern; no CI log or test execution was inspected.

Scope: Shared SMTP fixture consumers.
